explanation: A drum made on screen is one of the ten objects shown together in the room before the departure.
source_or_planning_basis: Production plan. The making is real; the object's later presence is arranged.
initial_audience_interpretation: A craft episode with no apparent connection to anything.
later_interpretation: The first of the ten objects the audience has already seen being made.
required_footage_or_research: Mark and retain the specific instrument; film it again in the room sequence.

explanation: A woven hana piece is among the ten objects.
source_or_planning_basis: Production plan, same as above.
initial_audience_interpretation: An episode about the last weaving households.
later_interpretation: The second object, and the one that dates the journey furthest back.
required_footage_or_research: Acquire the piece honestly and at a fair price; record the transaction.

explanation: The pilgrimage route is the spine of the underlying journey. Episode 100 Part B shows where Chathura joined it and where he left it.
source_or_planning_basis: Real annual event; the joining and leaving are production facts to be recorded as they happen.
initial_audience_interpretation: A documentary about a two-month walk.
later_interpretation: The walk that put him within reach of everything in seasons four to nine.
required_footage_or_research: Log dates and positions on the route during filming.

explanation: The Sri Pada trail is climbed once in season and once out of it. The empty climb belongs to Episode 100.
source_or_planning_basis: Two real shoots months apart.
later_interpretation: The same steps with nobody on them, immediately before the departure sequence.
required_footage_or_research: A second, out-of-season ascent with the same lenses and route.

explanation: The elephants released on screen are looked for again in the reconstruction.
source_or_planning_basis: Proposal for future filming. Post-release tracking by the Department of Wildlife Conservation is reported in sources seen only as search results; whether the same animals can be found again is unknown.
initial_audience_interpretation: An episode about preparing orphans for release.
later_interpretation: A return that may find them or may not, and either answer is the point.
required_footage_or_research: Access to post-release monitoring data and a second visit.

explanation: The cyclone of 28 November 2025 is the one hard dated marker the series has. Episode 100 uses it to sort the other episodes into before and after.
source_or_planning_basis: Proposal for how Episode 100 uses the date. The cyclone and the damage attributed to it are reported in sources seen only as search results.
initial_audience_interpretation: An episode about recovery from a disaster.
later_interpretation: The line that cuts the whole catalogue in two.
required_footage_or_research: Consistent date logging on every shoot.

explanation: One cascade physically links two episodes filmed months apart and presented as unrelated places.
source_or_planning_basis: Proposal. Which cascade the other locations sit in has not been surveyed, so the physical link is not established.
initial_audience_interpretation: An episode about restoring a tank system.
later_interpretation: Two villages the audience met separately are on the same water.
required_footage_or_research: Survey which cascade the other locations sit in before filming either.

explanation: The ordinary-day footage of the line at Peraliya runs under the departure sequence.
source_or_planning_basis: Production plan.
later_interpretation: The same rails, without the ceremony and without the crowd.
required_footage_or_research: Film the location on a non-anniversary day.

explanation: The last episode of the public journey is revealed to have happened long before the audience was shown it.
source_or_planning_basis: Production plan resting on a real journey.
initial_audience_interpretation: The series ending: a train to the end of a rebuilt line.
later_interpretation: Not an ending at all, and not last.
required_footage_or_research: Hold the terminus footage from public release until Episode 100.

explanation: The December 2025 floods are the damage the hill-line restoration episode is restoring.
source_or_planning_basis: Reported: both situations appear in the same published reporting, seen only as search results. The specific damage has not been confirmed with the operator.
initial_audience_interpretation: Two unrelated episodes in different seasons.
later_interpretation: The second is a consequence of the first, and the audience saw them in the wrong order.
required_footage_or_research: Confirm the specific damage with the operator or employer before claiming the link.

explanation: Reporting on the January 2026 wage agreement records that the same floods cut off dozens of estates.
source_or_planning_basis: Reported: both situations appear in the same published reporting, seen only as search results. The specific damage has not been confirmed with the employer.
initial_audience_interpretation: Two unrelated episodes in different seasons.
later_interpretation: The second is a consequence of the first, and the audience saw them in the wrong order.
required_footage_or_research: Confirm the specific damage with the operator or employer before claiming the link.

explanation: Central-district flooding and reservoir operation are part of the same water system.
source_or_planning_basis: Reported: both appear in the same published reporting, seen only as search results. That they are one water system is an interpretation to be checked.
initial_audience_interpretation: Two unrelated episodes in different seasons.
later_interpretation: The second is a consequence of the first, and the audience saw them in the wrong order.
required_footage_or_research: Confirm the specific damage with the operator or employer before claiming the link.

explanation: A drum made in the first episode is played in the procession.
source_or_planning_basis: Production plan; both events are real.
initial_audience_interpretation: Two separate films about a craft and a festival.
later_interpretation: The same instrument.
required_footage_or_research: Track the instrument from workshop to a named player in the procession.

explanation: The drum that accompanies the initiation is the one the audience watched being tuned.
source_or_planning_basis: Production plan.
later_interpretation: A sound the audience already knows.

explanation: Low-country ritual drumming and Kandyan drum making are different traditions using related instruments; the episodes should not pretend otherwise.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial. The difference is the point.
later_interpretation: Two distinct traditions the series has been careful not to blur.
required_footage_or_research: A musicologist check before either is cut.

explanation: Both are places where the number of people who come to look is the thing damaging what they came for.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial, resting on documented visitor pressure at both sites.
initial_audience_interpretation: A heritage episode and a wildlife episode.
later_interpretation: One argument, made twice in different materials.

explanation: The snares that kill leopards are set in the estate landscape where the wage episode is filmed.
source_or_planning_basis: Reported: a published mortality study, seen only as a search result, locates snare deaths in plantation mosaics in Nuwara Eliya. Any revisit is a proposal.
initial_audience_interpretation: A conservation episode and a labour episode.
later_interpretation: The same hillside, and the same people, seen from two directions.
required_footage_or_research: Do not film both in the same village without telling the community.

explanation: One episode watches people whose lives are threatened by elephants; the other watches people whose whole work is raising them.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial contrast between two documented situations.
later_interpretation: A single unresolved national relationship, from both ends.
required_footage_or_research: Nothing; they must not be cut together in a way that lectures either side.

explanation: The first shows a system being physically restored; the second shows the human arrangement that decides who gets the water in it.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial, resting on the same documented institution.
initial_audience_interpretation: An engineering story and a governance story.
later_interpretation: The restoration was the easy half.

explanation: A village that hands one person the power to decide, against a national system in which a million cases wait for a decision.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial contrast; both institutions are documented.
later_interpretation: Two answers to the same problem, at opposite scales.

explanation: Attention that is deliberately directed away from the mechanism, and attention so concentrated it damages its object.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial pairing between two independently researched situations.
initial_audience_interpretation: The audience learns that not looking can be part of the art.
later_interpretation: Looking has a cost in both directions.

explanation: Work nobody looks at, in a material everyone uses, and then work nobody looks at that everyone would rather not.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial pairing between two independently researched situations.
later_interpretation: The second is what the first becomes when the material is worthless.

explanation: One condition recognised for thirty years without a cause; one bite that must be identified in minutes without the snake.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial pairing between two independently researched situations.
later_interpretation: Recognition without understanding, at two speeds.

explanation: A skill with a window of weeks against a skill with a window of minutes.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial pairing between two independently researched situations.
initial_audience_interpretation: An agriculture episode and an emergency-services episode.
later_interpretation: The same question about arriving in time.

explanation: A skill that lives in the fingers and cannot be described, against a skill gated by permission before a person may begin.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial pairing between two independently researched situations.
later_interpretation: Two different things that the word training covers.

explanation: A dancer whose progress is certified by a teacher on a set night, against a keeper whose work nobody assesses at all.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial pairing between two independently researched situations.
later_interpretation: Two conditions under which a person decides they are doing it properly.

explanation: Giving something the body needs and remakes, against giving away everything a stall produces for one night.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial pairing between two independently researched situations.
later_interpretation: Two different economies of giving.

explanation: Fishermen paid for appearing to fish, against stallholders whose devotion is also a trade.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial pairing between two independently researched situations.
initial_audience_interpretation: One looks like a fake and one looks sincere.
later_interpretation: Both are people making a living out of what visitors want.

explanation: A miner alone underground with a stone, against a riverbed mined at night under a court order that is not enforced.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial pairing between two independently researched situations.
initial_audience_interpretation: A craft episode and a crime episode.
later_interpretation: Restraint at two scales, one of which has no witness and one of which has too many.

explanation: Men paid to protect what they used to take, against a landscape where a wire set for one animal kills another.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial pairing between two independently researched situations.
later_interpretation: Harm you intend and harm you leave behind.

explanation: Care deliberately withheld so an animal can survive without people, against care given to the one animal a street happens to know.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial pairing between two independently researched situations.
later_interpretation: Two shapes of care, neither of which is closeness.

explanation: A woman who leaves the country so her family can stay in it, against families working out who will look after a parent.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial pairing between two independently researched situations.
initial_audience_interpretation: A migration episode and an ageing episode.
later_interpretation: One obligation, met by leaving and by staying.

explanation: A family doing something for someone who cannot receive it, against families refusing a payment because it answers the wrong question.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial pairing between two independently researched situations.
later_interpretation: Two responses to an ending that will not close.

explanation: A community replanting what a local industry destroyed, against a court ordering a foreign company to pay for what it destroyed.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial pairing between two independently researched situations.
later_interpretation: Repair by hand and repair by judgment, and what each one can actually reach.

explanation: A workshop in its fifth generation that looks unchanged, against a casting method in which the original must be destroyed to make the object.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial pairing between two independently researched situations.
later_interpretation: Two accounts of how a thing stays itself.

explanation: A railway that stays the same by being continuously replaced, against a railway destroyed and rebuilt on its own formation.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial pairing between two independently researched situations.
later_interpretation: Continuity by replacement and continuity by return, and the difference between them.

explanation: A script nobody reads and a language children can pronounce but not use.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial pairing between two independently researched situations.
later_interpretation: Words outliving the people who could use them, in writing and in speech.

explanation: A ten-year-old preparing for a national selection examination, against a school with twelve children and one teacher covering five grades.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial pairing between two independently researched situations.
later_interpretation: The two ends of the same system, and the exam is what connects them.

explanation: A specialist leaving the country and a young woman leaving her province, both to be worth what somebody gave up.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial pairing between two independently researched situations.
later_interpretation: One mechanism at two levels of privilege.

explanation: A policy imposed quickly and paid for over years, against a target announced repeatedly and never reached.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial pairing between two independently researched situations.
later_interpretation: Deciding too fast and not deciding at all.

explanation: Turbines imposed on a fishing ground, against rooftop panels welcomed and then refused by the grid.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial pairing between two independently researched situations.
later_interpretation: The same transition, resisted from below and constrained from above.

explanation: A place where everyone ends up, against a place organised entirely around a known ending.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial pairing between two independently researched situations.
later_interpretation: One is administration and one is attention.

explanation: A dormant pull waiting for its trigger, and a case waiting seventeen years for a hearing.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial pairing between two independently researched situations.
later_interpretation: Two things that will not settle, one inside a person and one inside an institution.

explanation: A cinema with eight people in it, against a market moved wholesale to a bigger site and emptied of its trade.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial pairing between two independently researched situations.
later_interpretation: Space is not the problem in either case.

explanation: A price set by tasting in a room in Colombo, against a price agreed on a lorry park at three in the morning.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial pairing between two independently researched situations.
later_interpretation: Two ways a grower's year turns into a number.

explanation: Cane that requires a permit and land that becomes valuable: two cases of something held in common turning into something that can be taken.
source_or_planning_basis: Both sit under the same research question, SQ23.
initial_audience_interpretation: A craft decline and a housing programme.
later_interpretation: The same mechanism in a material and in a place.

explanation: Cultivators prosecuted for clearing forest, and a community whose hunting was made an offence by the same kind of instrument.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial parallel. Each situation is reported in its own sources, seen only as search results.
later_interpretation: One process, applied twice, forty years apart.
required_footage_or_research: Neither community should be filmed as an example of the other.

explanation: Research identifies farmers and daily wage labourers among the populations at higher risk of attempted suicide; the fertiliser episode is about farmers carrying debt.
source_or_planning_basis: Reported at population level in published research, seen only as a search result and not opened. Sensitive: this connection must never be drawn about a named person, and a clinical adviser must approve any use of it.
initial_audience_interpretation: A mental health episode and an agriculture episode.
later_interpretation: A relationship the research records and the film must not turn into a story about an individual.
required_footage_or_research: A clinical adviser must approve any edit that places these near each other.

explanation: Tapping and plucking, two skills leaving the plantations for the same reasons at the same time.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial pairing. Each trend is reported with separate figures in its own sources, seen only as search results.
later_interpretation: One labour story with two crops.

explanation: A forest monastery appears in season two. It is not the monastery of Episode 1, and the resemblance is deliberate.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial. The two places are different and the series must be able to prove it.
initial_audience_interpretation: A place that looks like the one in Episode 1.
later_interpretation: A different monastery, which is what makes the point.
required_footage_or_research: Establish clearly on screen that these are two places, or the connection becomes a lie.

explanation: A boat moving at walking pace beside a road, and a train running to the end of a line. Two ways of crossing the same country slowly.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial.
later_interpretation: A rhyme that closes the series.

explanation: A reservoir that drowned villages and a tank system being restored: the same technology at two scales and two centuries.
source_or_planning_basis: Editorial, resting on documented history.
later_interpretation: What the small system did without doing.
